caption: The drawing depicts a dress with an off-the-shoulder neckline and short sleeves, fitted at the bodice and flaring out into a wide, full skirt. The dress features a blue plaid pattern throughout, with darker blue lines forming a grid over a lighter background. The bodice has a pointed waistline and the pattern on it is arranged diagonally, while the pattern on the skirt is arranged horizontally and vertically. The sleeves are decorated with the same plaid pattern and are finished with a band above the elbow. To the upper right of the main colored illustration, there is a faint pencil sketch showing the back view of the dress, providing a simple outline and composition without additional color or shading. The background of the image is a plain, off-white color. No other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Dress
